# goutil.Env.Discover discards discovered env

### Welcome

- [x] Yes, I'm using a binary release within 2 latest [releases](https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/releases). Only such installations are supported.
- [x] Yes, I've searched similar [issues on GitHub](https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/issues) and didn't find any.
- [x] Yes, I've read the `typecheck` section of the [FAQ](https://golangci-lint.run/docs/welcome/faq/#why-do-you-have-typecheck-errors).
- [x] Yes, I've tried with the standalone [linter](https://golangci-lint.run/docs/linters/) if available (e.g., gocritic, go vet, etc.).
- [x] I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint?tab=coc-ov-file)

### How did you install golangci-lint?

Official binary

### Description of the problem

`goutil.Env.Discover` has a value receiver and assigns the discovered env to `e.vars`, so the result is written to a copy and discarded:

```go
func (e Env) Discover(ctx context.Context) error {
        var err error
        e.vars, err = goenv.Get(ctx, goenv.GOCACHE, goenv.GOROOT)
```

`PackageLoader.prepareBuildContext` returns early, so neither `build.Default.GOROOT` nor `os.Setenv("GOROOT", …)` is ever set. Release binaries are built with `-trimpath`, so `runtime.GOROOT()` is empty too. revive's `Package.TypeCheck` uses `importer.Default()`, which then can't find even standard-library packages:

```
   could not import strings (can't find import: "strings": cannot find package "strings" in any of:
        ($GOROOT not set)
        …/go/src/strings (from $GOPATH))
```

   As a result, revive's type-aware rules (`unhandled-error`, `string-of-int`, `time-equal`, `epoch-naming`, …) silently report nothing. This may be part of mgechev/revive#1277.

### Version of golangci-lint

package goutil

import (
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/mock"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/pkg/logutils"
)

func TestEnv_Discover(t *testing.T) {
	env := NewEnv(logutils.NewMockLog().OnInfof("Read go env for %s: %#v", mock.Anything, mock.Anything))

	err := env.Discover(t.Context())
	require.NoError(t, err)

	assert.Len(t, env.vars, 2)
}

func TestEnv_Get(t *testing.T) {
	const key = "GOLANGCI_LINT_TEST_ENV"

	env := NewEnv(logutils.NewStderrLog("skip"))

	env.vars[key] = "bar"

	t.Setenv(key, "foo")

	assert.Equal(t, "foo", env.Get(EnvKey(key)))

	_ = os.Unsetenv(key)

	assert.Equal(t, "bar", env.Get(EnvKey(key)))
}
